title: Causal Consistency of Structural Equation Models
claim_supported: Exact transformations formalize intervention consistency between structural causal models.
limitation: Requires specified models and interventions; graph resemblance is insufficient.

title: Performative Prediction
claim_supported: Predictions used in decisions can change the outcome distribution being modeled.
limitation: Convergence and stability results depend on formal assumptions.

title: Magentic Marketplace: An Open-Source Environment for Studying Agentic Markets
claim_supported: A simulated two-sided marketplace exposes search and offer-order effects in agent decisions.
limitation: Author-reported simulated results do not establish real-market outcomes.

title: ERC-8004: Trustless Agents
claim_supported: Draft proposes agent identity, reputation, and validation registries; payments are separate.
limitation: Draft as reviewed; registration and feedback do not certify delivered quality or independence.

title: x402 introduction
claim_supported: Describes HTTP-based resource access with payment verification and settlement.
limitation: Mutable documentation; payment success is not proof of useful delivery.

title: OpenTimestamps
claim_supported: Provides creation and verification of proofs of prior existence of committed bytes.
limitation: Does not establish truth, completeness, original publication time, or model information access.
